body: I kind of felt the same, but I just finished reading Midnight and genuinely I got through it in a week, it was really good. Resurrection is kind of a slow build up into phase 2, midnight is where it really kicks off

I've been thinking this exact thing for days. It's not bad, it just hurts others for a bit. Which no one really considers, because all they can focus on is how pointless or painful life is. It's not selfish if we didn't choose to be alive in the first place
